annotations.title: Get a campaign and its results

description: Returns one campaign, named by id, and its results together. The campaign: its state, number, template and the value of each blank, saved audience, time, quiet hours, and why it paused, stopped or could not start. The results: how many it was for, sent, delivered, read, replied, failed, were left out and are still to go, failures by group, sends per 10 minutes and what is left by day. A reply counts for 72 hours after the campaign ends. Read-only.
